findings.status: NEW, found this round; PRE-EXISTING since the round-2 D10 build (NOT caused by the F1 fix)
findings.title: D10's brand gate is disarmed on the tier-pick turn of the ask->pick round-trip
findings.customer_boundary: Contact entitled ONLY to Sorento (['Sorento Dealer','Sorento Office']) asks 'cabana promo for CBS212-WH'. Turn 1: tier-gate closes the brand gate (brand_unheld=true, brand_gate_empty=true) but tier_ask=true outranks it, so they are asked to pick a tier for a brand they cannot see. Turn 2: they reply '2' and receive two CABANA DEALER USE PDFs — 2 send-message-files would_send entries, no denial anywhere.
findings.mechanism: The LLM expands the numbered pick into _parser_raw.access_levels = ['Sorento Dealer','Mocha Dealer','Cabana Dealer'] (it enumerates every compound level it knows). output_exchange's statedBrands() UNIONS the brand half of every raw level into query_brands, so query_brands becomes ['sorento','cabana','mocha'] — brands the customer never named. tier-gate then evaluates brandUnheld = qb.length>0 && entMap.brands.length>0 && !qb.some(b => entMap.brands.includes(b)); 'sorento' satisfies some(), brandUnheld goes FALSE, brand_gate_empty goes FALSE, promo-picker's D10 guard never fires. Note the carried cabana brand ENTITY is present and correct on that turn — it is the union with the LLM's level expansion that widens the set and opens the gate.
findings.why_it_matters: D10 exists specifically so that an access boundary does not depend on the CRM's response to access_levels (plan D10 / UAC BLOCKER-2). On this path n8n performs no denial at all and safety falls back onto exactly the undocumented CRM filtering D10 was written to stop trusting. The same root cause also widens access_levels_recomposed on every tier-pick turn (F7).
findings.reproduced: 2/2 — execs 12055181 and 12055497, both with _parser_raw.access_levels = ['Sorento Dealer','Mocha Dealer','Cabana Dealer'].
findings.round2_status_by_code_read: The round-2 predicate was qb.length>0 && !qb.some(...); with qb=['sorento','cabana','mocha'] and entitled brands ['sorento'] it evaluates identically, so round 2 had the same hole. Round 2 never ran an ask->pick round-trip under a brand-denied contact. Labelled as a code read, not a measurement — I did not republish bba611fa.
findings.reachability: Needs a contact that is multi-tier AND brand-limited. plan §7's live histogram contains one such shape (['dealer','end_user','sorento_office']); whether the compound display names the CRM returns for it parse into >1 tier is unverified. Post-CRM-split any brands x tiers combination becomes expressible, which plan §7 already flags as moving from 'cannot occur' to merely 'unpopulated'.
findings.suggested_shape_of_fix: Two candidates, both for the planner not the tester: (a) query_brands must mean 'brands the customer named' — derive it from the message/entities and the raw levels of the CURRENT message only, never from an LLM enumeration of the entitlement; and/or (b) tier-gate should carry the arrange-turn brand decision across the round-trip rather than recomputing it from a pick turn's parser output. Separately: when brand_gate_empty is true on the ARRANGE turn, the ask should not fire at all — the customer is being asked to choose a tier for content that is already fully denied.

findings.status: STILL OPEN, and round 3 shows a WORSE state than round 2 — but the mechanism is not word order
findings.title: the SEARCH half depends on a brand ENTITY the parser emits nondeterministically
findings.detail: Round 2 measured 'cabana promo for CBS212-WH dealer' -> 2 files vs 'cabana dealer promo for CBS212-WH' -> dead-end, and attributed it to word order. In round 3 the two word orders are INDISTINGUISHABLE — identical parser output (entities = product only, NO hint:'brand' entity, access_levels ['dealer'], query_brands ['cabana']) and identical replies — across 6 samples on 2 products. Both CBS212-WH phrasings now dead-end ('No promotion for CBS212-WH. Try: CBS202-WH, CBS204-WH'), where round 2's exec 12045322 sent a 'Cabana' token to the resolver (15 promotion matches) and answered. So the variable is whether the LLM emits the brand entity AT ALL, not the order of the words; in round 3 it emitted none in any sample. D9 did deterministically fix the ACCESS half — query_brands is ['cabana'] in every sample regardless of order — the SEARCH scope still rides on the nondeterministic entity. Substitute product CBS202-WH answers under both orders (the promotion is attached to the product, so no brand token is needed).

reasons: F6 is a BLOCKER: on a reachable path (multi-tier, brand-limited contact -> ask -> pick) the D10 brand gate performs no denial and files for an unentitled brand reach the customer. It is pre-existing since round 2 rather than caused by the F1 fix, but it is an access boundary that the plan's own D10 says must be enforced in n8n and it is not.
